title: Pushbutton
summary: Light the built-in LED while a button is pressed, using INPUT_PULLUP.
learningObjectives: Enable the internal pull-up with INPUT_PULLUP.
expectedBehavior: Pressing the virtual button lights the built-in D13 LED.
wiringChecklist: No external pull-down (that would contradict INPUT_PULLUP).
predictPrompt: When the button is NOT pressed, is D2 HIGH or LOW?
observePrompt: Press and release the button. Does the LED follow?
tryNext: Invert the logic so the LED is on when the button is released.
